payload.description_html:
Seen here is a model-based reconstruction of life on an ancient forest floor during the Pennsylvanian Period - the "Age of Coal Swamps". This is a public exhibit at the Cincinnati Museum of Natural History & Science in Cincinnati, Ohio.

The vertebrate that has buried itself in sediments represents Gnathorhiza, a fossil lungfish.

See info. at: <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lungfish" rel="nofollow">en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lungfish</a> and <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gnathorhizidae" rel="nofollow">en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gnathorhizidae</a> and
